title: Themescape Escape Rooms
specs: Highly themed rooms with state of the art technology and puzzles
Groups of 13 year olds and younger must be accompanied by at least one adult
All participants must sign a liability waiver; minors require a parent or guardian to sign
Physically able to perform tasks including crawling, standing, bending, walking, lifting 20 lbs or less
No intoxication or unruly behavior allowed
Minimum players: 2 for Submergency, 3 for Stolen Relic, 4 for Mystical Manor
Private bookings; no other groups join your game
blurb: Guests play live-action escape room games where they solve puzzles and find clues to complete a mission within 60 minutes. Each game is exclusive to the booking party and designed for young adults and up, with children welcome if accompanied by adults. The experience includes a briefing, the game, and a group photo session, totaling about 90 minutes at the facility.
extraNote: Strict no refund policy · No penalty to reschedule 48 hours before reservation · $25 rescheduling fee if within 48 hours of reservation · Arrive 15 minutes prior to reservation · Late arrival reduces game time; no refunds or reschedules for late or no-shows
